summary: Test suite covers core glob patterns, multiple labels, and priority ordering with 11 unit tests + workflow structure validation. End-to-end tested via act harness with 2 fixture cases (docs-and-api, priority-conflict). However, critical gaps exist: basename-pattern matching logic is in code but not explicitly tested; edge cases (special regex chars, case sensitivity, invalid fixtures) are missing; fixture file contents are referenced but not shown; only 2 end-to-end test cases run through act despite 11 unit tests defined; Invoke-LabelAssigner.ps1 entry-point error handling (invalid JSON, missing required fixture fields) not directly tested in Pester. Would catch happy-path regressions but miss edge cases and some integration scenarios.
